reply.summary: Lloollrer is the last ruler of a river kingdom, a charismatic politician who wins allies through charm and a trick amulet. She outmaneuvers a sibling co-ruler and talks a would-be conqueror out of invading.

feats.scene: Lloollrer commands a legion of archers to unleash a volley that darkens the dusk over the river.
Lloollrer shrugs off a lunge from a cornered assassin in her marble hall.

reply.summary: Lornanse is an orphan who spends afternoons outside a famous prisoner's cell, then grows into a costumed avenger with an oversized pet. She hunts the heir of a godlike physicist.

feats.scene: Lornanse hurls a rusty machine part against a bunker door and dents it.
Lornanse climbs from rubble after a ceiling slab clips her shoulder.

reply.summary: Rnsaneo is a trapeze artist and widower who runs a roadside inn, helps stop a smuggling ring, and later lends his body to a restless ghost. He ends up killed mid-act, just as his twin did.

feats.scene: Rnsaneo swings from a high bar and kicks a lurking thug off a platform.
Rnsaneo lands hard on a safety net and bounces to his feet.

reply.summary: Eonvasse is a boastful teen prodigy who torments classmates, then dons a head-worn gadget that makes him a scheming adversary. His arrogance eventually costs him dearly.

feats.scene: Eonvasse rigs a mechanical cart to flatten a locker row at school.
Eonvasse stumbles down a stairwell after a prank backfires and keeps sneering.

reply.summary: Rustirore is a roving daredevil who wears an octopus carcass as a scare tactic, test-flies a sabotaged plane, and wrestles polar bears. He picks up a secret survival recipe along the way.

feats.scene: Rustirore drives a jagged icicle through a charging bear's flank.
Rustirore rides out a nosedive crash landing in a snowfield.

reply.summary: Riaarco is a scheming mastermind who joins a cabal of tyrants in a cartoon world, planning from a shadowed base. He prefers brains to brawling.

feats.scene: Riaarco triggers a hidden turret array that levels a loading dock.
Riaarco ducks behind a console as sparks spray across the room.

reply.summary: Rnasos is a living brain inside a mechanical shell, a loyal member of a team of oddball heroes. A mad inventor once swaps his brain, then redeems himself at a terrible price.

feats.scene: Rnasos punches a hole through a steel bulkhead during a rescue.
Rnasos is flattened by a falling girder and clanks upright again.

reply.summary: Saura is a cyborg hero with a wisecracking streak, whose near-unbreakable metal body carries him through rescue missions. He stays loyal to his leader even as a shapeshifter sabotages them.

feats.scene: Saura tears a steel hatch from its frame to free a trapped crew.
Saura endures a crushing coil of stretched arms around his chassis.

reply.summary: Setinrus is a gruff ex-driver whose brain was moved into a hulking mechanical frame after a crash, leaving him angry yet tender. He loves his family and curses his team.

feats.scene: Setinrus lifts a wrecked sedan overhead and flings it over a fence.
Setinrus stands in a pile-up of cars without a dent.
Setinrus sprints down a flooded road in a borrowed racing machine.

reply.summary: Ruscosto is a cynical daredevil whose crash was answered by microscopic machines that grew a metal shell around his living brain. He works as a lawyer and a hero, and curses both jobs.

feats.scene: Ruscosto pounds a runaway truck into a ditch with both fists.
Ruscosto crawls from a burning wreck as tiny machines mend his casing.

reply.summary: Terause is a tough bodyguard to a corrupt politician, once a thug in a rough port town. He cracks fast when his bank balance is threatened and gives up his boss.

feats.scene: Terause drives a fist into a kidnapper's ribs inside a van.
Terause sits through an interrogation with a cut lip and a smirk.

reply.summary: Lusto is a shy scribe who keeps a great archive on an island of warrior women and befriends a young princess. A snake-haired spirit once possessed her until a queen lifted the curse.

feats.scene: Lusto topples a stack of heavy scrolls onto a spectre-possessed intruder.
Lusto recovers from a possession without lasting harm.

reply.summary: Tortini is a gun-for-hire who roams every corner of the globe, known for slipping any knot taught by a street mystic. He leaves enemies dead and friends scattered.

feats.scene: Tortini fires both revolvers into a gang's lantern rack and drops the room into darkness.
Tortini rolls clear of a collapsing market stall without a scratch.

reply.summary: Vaunau is a brutal masked crusader of the lean years who marks the ears of lawbreakers and attends galas under false names. He mentors a street kid and passes on his costume.

feats.scene: Vaunau flattens two goons with a pair of cane swings in a dim alley.
Vaunau walks home from a brawl with a split lip, still tipsy.

reply.summary: Telnelto is a married homicide detective, level-headed and methodical, who accepts a coworker's odd explanations about her hunches. He solves cases by patience and notes.

feats.scene: Telnelto tackles a fleeing suspect over a parked sedan's hood.
Telnelto walks off a scuffle with a bruised elbow and a grin.

reply.summary: Nunensto is a white-haired thief who builds gadgets that bend the hours, clashing with archers and sneaking technology from a rival traveler. He lashes out with prehistoric flyers pulled from the past.

feats.scene: Nunensto springs a time-trap that detonates a warehouse floor in a blue flash.
Nunensto staggers up after a fall from a gantry and resets his device.

reply.summary: Iumerco is a bald crime boss who mails riddling machines to masked crimefighters as a smokescreen for his real heists. He is caught once his scheme is read.

feats.scene: Iumerco sets off a decoy clockwork bomb that blasts a gap in a jewelry shop wall.
Iumerco bolts across a rooftop and lands in a heap without injury.

reply.summary: Irnleocor is a green-haired servant of a dark tyrant from a fiery world, known for oversized fangs that gnaw through nearly any material. He snarls instead of speaking.

feats.scene: Irnleocor chews through a steel chain with a single clench.
Irnleocor shakes off a plunge into a lava channel.

reply.summary: Rnilust is the youngest of three weaver goddesses who spins the glowing thread that measures every life. She witnesses trials and sews a famous warrior's costume.

feats.scene: Rnilust snaps a silver thread and ends a mortal's story in an instant.
Rnilust sits unmoved as a rockslide thunders over her loom.

reply.summary: Anistati is a stern army sergeant in a metropolis who serves in a special unit under a general. He keeps his orders short and his emotions shorter.

feats.scene: Anistati hurls a smoke canister through a hangar window.
Anistati drills through a training course in full kit without slowing.

reply.summary: Liamo is a blue-haired teen who turns into a wisp of vapor and commands storms. Her mind frays as she uses more power, and she must release the surplus to regain clarity.

feats.scene: Liamo gathers a thunderhead and drops a lightning storm onto a parking lot.
Liamo thins into mist and lets a hail of rounds pass through.

reply.summary: Rniser is a red-haired sidekick turned independent crimefighter after a bitter breakup with her partner. She hits hard with arrows and fists and occasionally teams up again.

feats.scene: Rniser pins a purse-snatcher's coat to a fence with a well-placed arrow.
Rniser takes a plank swing across the back and keeps fighting.

reply.summary: Nalserre is one half of a pair of identical, well-meaning but bumbling private detectives in a humor strip. He gets lucky as often as he fails.

feats.scene: Nalserre swings a magnifying glass and accidentally clobbers a burglar.
Nalserre trips down a flight of stairs and bounces up smiling.

reply.summary: Irnntota is a mute lump of living clay that wanders off, wakes up, and is twisted by a laughing toxin into a mad killer. He rampages through an asylum until frozen solid.

feats.scene: Irnntota swells and crushes a guard post in the asylum yard.
Irnntota stays standing after a rifle volley and a freezing blast.

reply.summary: Iumneres is a petty crook who wastes his jail time on frivolous lawsuits and later fires at patrol officers for a sinister benefactor. He aims for the chest and earns a scolding.

feats.scene: Iumneres empties a pistol at a squad car from behind a dumpster.
Iumneres rolls clear of a flying door and sprints for a getaway van.

reply.summary: Aulleere is a deranged man who slaughters his own family and later prowls alleys, convinced he is a famed nocturnal avenger. He is cornered by the real one.

feats.scene: Aulleere swings a rusty pipe into a victim's door and splits the wood.
Aulleere flails out of a dumpster fall and snarls.

reply.summary: Corsiri is a hairless alien thief who channels a greedy emotional glow as a ring-bearer, once a corpse serving a dead army. She hails from a crowded thieves' world.

feats.scene: Corsiri forms a glowing hand and squeezes a docked freighter's hull until it buckles.
Corsiri shrugs off a bolt of searing light aboard a derelict ship.

reply.summary: Rorstlin is a blue-skinned conqueror, once a gentle boy from a peaceful world whose people shared thoughts each day. Enslaved by a star-shaped parasite, he rises as a galactic tyrant.

feats.scene: Rorstlin commands a fleet to bombard a moon-sized station into drifting rubble.
Rorstlin stands through a barrage of orbital lances.

reply.summary: Aunian is a flying hired gun on a mercenary squad paid to kill a hitman. She and her teammates are taken down in a single messy night.

feats.scene: Aunian empties a submachine gun from midair at a fleeing van.
Aunian takes a clipped shoulder and keeps circling the rooftop.

reply.summary: Minumna is an insect-themed heroine in an alternate timeline, one of a group of bug-styled fighters lost in an assault on warrior islanders. She is squashed like her namesake.

feats.scene: Minumna jabs a hostile soldier's ankle with a spiked leg.
Minumna scuttles through a pile of rubble without injury.

reply.summary: Serno is a thrill-seeking teen from a trailer park, abducted by aliens and returned with an unbreakable hide. He dives into danger because he cannot be hurt, yet still needs air.

feats.scene: Serno bowls a stolen cart through a barrier of crates in a canyon chase.
Serno takes a rocket blast to the chest and walks out of the smoke.

reply.summary: Rnicel is a rebellious young hero with an impervious hide who lost an arm in a street war yet could not be pierced. He is drowned in a harbor by three shadowy posthumans.

feats.scene: Rnicel kicks a stalled car off a ramp to clear a path for fleeing locals.
Rnicel shrugs off a collapsing parking deck and checks his collar.

reply.summary: Ultaseo is a titan who rules the night sky from a dark estate, sibling to a family of primeval giants. He lulls foes to sleep and mourns his departed bride.

feats.scene: Ultaseo hurls a boulder-fall of lunar rock that carves a trench across a continent.
Ultaseo stands unmarked as a barrage of divine lances rains across his shoulders.

reply.summary: Sercoan is a pale regular at a hidden London tavern for costumed folk, apparently a bloodsucker who keeps to dim corners. He nurses a drink and says little.

feats.scene: Sercoan tosses a rowdy patron through a window with a single heave.
Sercoan walks out of a stairwell collapse and adjusts his cuffs.

reply.summary: Coninau is a criminal who gained the knack of commanding anything rope-like after a mass event. She plots with her partner to ambush a teen hero and hoist him upside down.

feats.scene: Coninau whips a dozen cables around a bridge rail and snaps it free.
Coninau dodges a thrown rock and keeps her hold on the lines.

reply.summary: Ortorreo is a springy bad guy conjured by a hero's mysterious boss, stretching and compressing like a steel coil. He kidnaps a detective for his master.

feats.scene: Ortorreo uncoils and snaps a lamppost in half with a whip-crack of his body.
Ortorreo bounces off a brick wall and springs back into shape.

reply.summary: Noanto is a seasoned marine sergeant in the Pacific war who supervises an experimental killing machine and its sequel. He trusts the robot more than most recruits.

feats.scene: Noanto fires a rifle volley from a foxhole that pins a patrol down.
Noanto stays in the line through a mortar barrage and shakes dirt from his helmet.

reply.summary: Iuamrno is a brown-haired journalist with a nose for stories in a timeline-hopping team's era. She chases leads relentlessly.

feats.scene: Iuamrno slams a notebook on a bureaucrat's desk to demand a statement.
Iuamrno stays on her feet through a jostling press scrum.

reply.summary: Orasirtal is a white-haired hired gun whose frosty aura keeps him from ever touching his sweetheart. He freezes barriers, fights masked vigilantes and is eventually jailed.

feats.scene: Orasirtal sprays a wave of cold and freezes a whole dock into a glaze.
Orasirtal tumbles from a crane and brushes frost from his sleeves.

reply.summary: Eonnutor is a pale-haired criminal who chills the air around his enemies in a cartoon short. He is a nuisance more than a menace.

feats.scene: Eonnutor flash-freezes a fountain and a row of parked cars in a single breath.
Eonnutor takes a punch and keeps grinning through chattering teeth.

reply.summary: Neoroeo is a former hustler turned alien-hunter in a bleak possible future, leading a rebellion against a machine overlord. His senses stretch to catch hidden infiltrators and travellers from elsewhere.

feats.scene: Neoroeo detonates a salvaged power cell and brings down a corridor of drones.
Neoroeo crashes through a skylight into a nest of enemies and keeps firing.

reply.summary: Valsetor is a covert field agent presumed lost years ago, then recruited by a mysterious boss to undermine a spy agency's schemes. He plans quiet sabotage and trusts his team's gifts.

feats.scene: Valsetor rigs a charge that collapses a guard tower at a black site.
Valsetor drops from a catwalk onto concrete and runs on.

reply.summary: Colloll is a brown-haired traveller who roams the roads on an eerie mount as a loner adventurer. He follows rumours and keeps few friends.

feats.scene: Colloll rams a gate open with his skeletal motorcycle in a night raid.
Colloll tumbles from his mount at speed and rolls upright.
Colloll opens the throttle down a dark highway and outruns a patrol.

reply.summary: Lleeon is a blinded former painter who glimpsed the forge where worlds are born and now remolds matter with creative fire. He seeks redemption among a trio of multiversal guardians.

feats.scene: Lleeon reshapes a rocky hillside into a glowing cathedral of glass in seconds.
Lleeon knits his torso back together after a blast tears through it.

reply.summary: Miariaan is a red-haired orphan, given a strange transfusion, who wears a trench coat and races rivals through a harbor town. He is quick and strong and dreams of finding his mother.

feats.scene: Miariaan wrestles a hulking rival into a stack of crates on a pier.
Miariaan shrugs off a rooftop tumble and laughs.
Miariaan wins a street race against a boastful strongman.

reply.summary: Ntnti is a frightened ten-year-old orphan who collects clippings and clutches a stuffed bear, transformed by a mad doctor's serum into a towering brute. He chooses to fight crime in a trench coat and brass knuckles.

feats.scene: Ntnti swells to monstrous size and punches a van across an alley.
Ntnti stands in a hail of rifle fire as a hulking behemoth.

reply.summary: Necorrus is a swarm of floating orbs that learned to think by absorbing a bird-like creature and a borrowed power cell. It polices a quiet sector with a ring that makes glowing constructs.

feats.scene: Necorrus fires a lance of green light that vaporizes a small asteroid.
Necorrus scatters and reforms after a blast tears through its swarm.

reply.summary: Tiurernt is a white-haired hoarder who gathers valuables by shady means, then buys a cherished keepsake from a famous reporter's pal. A hidden sensor in it ends his career.

feats.scene: Tiurernt shatters a display case with a cane to snatch a medallion.
Tiurernt stumbles from a scuffle with a sore shoulder and a sneer.

reply.summary: Tanreo is a red-eyed android conqueror from a distant world who hungers for every scrap of knowledge. His body resists most attacks, and he fires force and heat from his hands.

feats.scene: Tanreo levels a mountain fortress with a single beam of heat.
Tanreo stands in the blast of a missile salvo and straightens his collar.

reply.summary: Rnniulan is a blunt, headstrong police detective who adopts a masked persona with several neighbors after a hero vanishes. She trusts her sidearm and her instincts.

feats.scene: Rnniulan fires a double tap that drops a gunman behind a dumpster.
Rnniulan takes a vest-hit and keeps chasing a suspect over rooftops.
